analyze_model_flops: analyze the FLOPs of a detectron2 model using operator-level flop counting with FlopCountAnalysis
count_model_activations: count the activations of a detectron2 model per operator using activation_count_operators
count_model_flops_operators: count the FLOPs per operator for a detectron2 model using flop_count_operators
find_unused_model_parameters: find parameters in a detectron2 model that do not contribute to the loss using find_unused_parameters
analyze_model_parameters: count and display the parameter count table for a detectron2 model using parameter_count and parameter_count_table
